title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry continues to see a mix of collaboration and competition as companies gear up for new projects and funding rounds. Notably, satellite production efficiency is on the rise while some hypersonic ambitions remain grounded.

themes.title: Satellite Production Partnerships
themes.body: Fotrastra and Hadrian's collaboration aims to streamline satellite production, reflecting a broader trend of consolidation in the sector. As companies seek to cut costs and improve timelines, expect more alliances to emerge.

themes.title: Funding in Space Situational Awareness
themes.body: A Chinese startup's recent fundraising for a space situational awareness constellation highlights the growing commercial interest in this niche. With multiple players entering the field, competition for contracts and innovation will likely intensify.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Space Resilience
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup adds $1.4 billion to the space resilience line, signaling a stronger commitment to safeguarding U.S. interests in orbit. This funding could accelerate projects aimed at enhancing national security in space.

themes.title: Hypersonic Testing Delays
themes.body: The latest hypersonic glide-vehicle test has slipped for the third consecutive quarter, raising questions about the viability of these advanced systems. As funding pours into defense tech, stakeholders will be watching closely for any signs of progress.
